`voice-tone.mp3` is a two-second, locally generated sine-wave test fixture (FFmpeg lavfi sine source, MP3 at 128 kbps). It contains no speech, personal data, provider recording or licensed music. Browser tests use it to exercise actual MP3 decoding, the Web Audio graph and replay timing. It is never shipped as an attendee-facing fallback. Real provider generation is tested separately without saving its audio.
